taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants 80-100 cm tall; FNA 12-17 dm.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants cespitose from stout horizontal rhizomes; herbs.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): perennial herbs.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): basal leaves deciduous by flowering.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems sulcate, erect.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): basal leaves 1 or 2, gone by flowering, so the plant is a leafy stem.

traits.shoot_leaves.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: a leafy flowering stem of 8 to 15 alternate leaves, smaller upward (FNA: stems leafy).

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets green above, white-tomentose beneath; sRGB by eye.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaf blade pinnate.

traits.division_pattern.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pinnate, with 2-5 pairs of leaflets.

traits.division_order.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets undivided, with smaller leaflets between the pairs; the end leaflet palmately 3-5-lobed.

traits.terminal_leaflet.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): terminal leaflet round, 3-7 cm, palmately lobed.

traits.leaflets.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 2-5 pairs of leaflets and the end one; FNA 2-4 pairs.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stem leaves 10 cm to 30 cm long.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): lateral leaflets 2-6 cm.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: lateral leaflets 1.5 cm to 3.5 cm wide, ovate.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): lateral leaflets ovate to elliptic.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflet apex acuminate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margins doubly serrate.

traits.leaf_hairs_beneath.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets white tomentose beneath; FNA greyish tomentose or hairy on the nerves.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescence terminal, paniculate.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences 100+-flowered.

traits.inflorescence_branches.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: 6 to 12 primary branches.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: the panicle 10 cm to 25 cm long.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers about 5 mm across.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals 2.5-5 mm, white to cream.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals white to cream; sRGB by eye for cream.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 20-40, longer than the petals.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): achenes 6-8, flattened, twisted.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): achenes 3-6 mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: achenes brown when ripe.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering and fruiting June to September; FNA July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 9 (2003), Filipendula ulmaria (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruiting June to September; drawn from August.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a clump of upright leafy stems with pinnate leaves, white beneath, topped by frothy cream panicles of tiny flowers.

allometry.note: 1.1 m tall at 3 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
